<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

A grid of two lanes and four phases. The phases run across the top: engagement and scoping, design, analysis, and delivery, communication and sign-off.

The top lane is work where no impact dimension scores Level 4. Step 1, score the impact, is in engagement and scoping. Step 2, score the likelihood, and step 3, read your level, are in design. Step 4, do what your level requires, runs from design to the end of delivery, communication and sign-off.

The lower lane is work where an impact dimension scores Level 4, which makes it Business Critical. Steps 1, 2 and 3 are all in engagement and scoping, and step 4 runs from there to the end of delivery, communication and sign-off.

| Step | When |
|---|---|
| **1. Score the impact** | Phase 1, scoping |
| **2. Score the likelihood** | Phase 2, design. **Phase 1 where an impact dimension scored 4** |
| **3. Read your level** | Phase 2, design. **Phase 1 where an impact dimension scored 4** |
| **4. Do what your level requires** | Phases 2 to 4. **Phase 1 onwards where an impact dimension scored 4** |

: When each of the four steps happens, for both routes

</div>
</details>
